alerts.name: AtmoSync Critical Spoilage Risk Alert
alerts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ANALYTICS.FCT_SPOILAGE_ARBITRAGE WHERE RISK_LEVEL = 'CRITICAL'

alerts.name: High Arbitrage Reroute Opportunity Alert
alerts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ANALYTICS.FCT_SPOILAGE_ARBITRAGE WHERE ARBITRAGE_OPPORTUNITY_FLAG = TRUE AND NET_ARBITRAGE_PROFIT_INR > 35000
